title: Radio: John Lennon and Yoko Ono for WPLJ | 1971
content:
John Lennon and Yoko Ono gave an interview to Howard Smith from the radio station WPLJ on 9 September 1971.

Smith had previously interviewed the pair about their debut solo albums, and repeated the format for the follow-ups, Imagine and Fly. The discussion took place at Lennon and Ono’s suite at the St Regis Hotel, Manhattan.

Much of the focus was on Ono’s art projects and a forthcoming reissue of her 1964 book Grapefruit. Lennon also discussed their latest film project, Imagine, and the song ‘How Do You Sleep?’, which was aimed at Paul McCartney.

The only subject that was off-limits was drugs. Smith later revealed that Lennon and Ono were on methadone at the time, in an attempt to stay free from opiates.
